Scenario Description: Drug Cabinet Presets link opens the presets list
Expected Result: URL /admin/drugs/presets; New Preset, Search… and Back shown; columns Preset Name, Notes, Number of Drugs.

Scenario Description: Direct URL navigation preserves session
Expected Result: List renders without login redirect.

Scenario Description: Unauthenticated access to the editor is redirected
Expected Result: Redirect to /login; editor never rendered.

Scenario Description: Back links return to list and Drug Cabinet
Test Steps: 1. Click New Preset; 2. Click editor Back; 3. Click list Back
Expected Result: Editor Back → /admin/drugs/presets; list Back → /admin/drugs.

Scenario Description: Searching by preset name filters the list
Preconditions: Unique preset created by the test
Test Steps: 1. Open list; 2. Search the preset name
Expected Result: Exactly one row, the matching preset. Preset deleted afterwards.

Scenario Description: Non-matching search shows the empty state
Expected Result: "No Drug Presets Found" and "Add a drug preset to get started."; no rows.

Scenario Description: Clear control resets the filter
Expected Result: Search box empty; empty state gone; table headers shown.

Scenario Description: Pager shows position; Previous does nothing on page 1
Test Steps: 1. Inspect pager; 2. Click Previous; 3. If N = 1, click Next
Expected Result: Indicator 1/N; clicking Previous (and Next when N = 1) keeps the indicator and sends no list request. See OBS-PRS-001.

Scenario Description: New editor opens blank with one default row
Expected Result: Name/Notes empty with Required/Optional hints; columns Generic/Brand, Dosage, Frequency, Route, Duration; one blank row with Route PO; no Delete Preset; zero writes.

Scenario Description: Drug Cabinet suggestion autofills the row
Preconditions: Amoxicillin in Drug Cabinet; writes blocked
Test Steps: 1. Type Amox in Generic name; 2. Pick Amoxicillin
Expected Result: Row filled with Amoxicillin, 500 mg, TDS, Oral.

Scenario Description: Add Medication appends; Move up reorders
Test Steps: 1. Fill row 1; 2. Add Medication, fill row 2; 3. Move row 2 up
Test Data: Amoxicillin 500 mg TDS 5 days; Paracetamol 1 g QID 3 days
Expected Result: Two rows in entry order; after Move up, Paracetamol is first with all values intact.

Scenario Description: Remove deletes only the selected row
Expected Result: Only Paracetamol remains.

Scenario Description: Clear All resets medications to one blank row
Preconditions: Writes blocked; two rows and a name
Expected Result: One blank row (Route PO); preset name kept; zero writes.

Scenario Description: Empty preset shows name and medication errors
Expected Result: "Required" under Name and "At least one medication is required"; stays on /edit/new; zero writes.

Scenario Description: Name without medication is rejected
Expected Result: "At least one medication is required"; no name error; zero writes.

Scenario Description: Medication without name is rejected
Expected Result: "Required" under Name; zero writes.

Scenario Description: Whitespace-only name is rejected
Expected Result: Save blocked; zero writes. Known defect DEF-PRS-001 (test.fail()).

Scenario Description: Row without generic name is rejected
Test Steps: 1. Name plus row with dosage only; 2. Save
Expected Result: Save blocked; zero writes. Known defect DEF-PRS-002 (test.fail()).

Scenario Description: Drug without dosage and frequency is rejected
Expected Result: Save blocked; zero writes. Known defect DEF-PRS-003 (test.fail()).

Scenario Description: Creating a two-drug preset saves and lists it
Test Steps: 1. Fill name, notes, two medications; 2. Save; 3. Search list
Test Data: Notes Take after meals; Amoxicillin 500 mg TDS Oral 5 days; Paracetamol 1 g QID 3 days
Expected Result: POST /drugPresets → 201 "Preset created successfully"; redirect to /edit/:id with Delete Preset; list row shows notes and "2 Drugs". Deleted afterwards.

Scenario Description: Saved preset reopens with medications in saved order
Expected Result: Name, notes and both rows (all five fields) match the saved values in the saved order.

Scenario Description: Edit persists new name and medication list
Preconditions: Two-drug preset created by the test
Expected Result: PUT /drugPresets?id=:id → 200 "Preset updated successfully"; after reload only Paracetamol remains with the new name; list shows "1 Drug".

Scenario Description: Cancelling delete keeps the preset
Expected Result: Dialog: "Are you sure you want to delete this preset? This action cannot be undone."; after Cancel the dialog closes and the preset is still listed.

Scenario Description: Confirming delete removes the preset
Expected Result: DELETE /drugPresets?id=:id → 204; redirect to list; search for the name shows "No Drug Presets Found".
